title: Bridging the Divide Between Agricultural Economics and the Sustainability Sciences
title_zh: 弥合农业经济学与可持续性科学之间的鸿沟
title_primary: 弥合农业经济学与可持续性科学之间的鸿沟
title_secondary: Bridging the Divide Between Agricultural Economics and the Sustainability Sciences
authors: Thomas W. Hertel
official: 官方在线 2026-09-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This article is based on several decades of experience engaging in interdisciplinary research and teaching involving agronomists, climate scientists, ecologists, hydrologists and geographers, focused on ensuring the long run sustainability of local and global food systems. Through a series of examples of this research, the paper will underscore several key points. The first is that keeping the economics as simple as possible leaves greater room for interdisciplinary collaboration. The more complex the economic models, the higher the barrier to effective collaboration. Basic economic messages on the role of markets in mediating the impacts of policies, along with producer and consumer responses to changing incentives are invaluable to sustainability analyses and can lend important new insights. This doesn’t mean that the ensuing economic analysis is not sophisticated. Indeed, as will be demonstrated, sophisticated analysis is critically important. But this analysis is at the ‘extensive margin’ of economic science—applying established methods to new application domains. A second point is that economists must work at the same spatial resolution as our science collaborators. For food, land and water sustainability challenges, this is typically the grid cell—geospatial units identified by latitude and longitude coordinates. Economists have been slow on the uptake of the geospatial data revolution. For me personally, this has meant moving, over the last two decades, from national scale general equilibrium modelling to gridded partial equilibrium modelling. Ultimately, these two frameworks can be combined, as I will demonstrate in this paper. Many sustainability analyses must start at the granular level where one can leverage the full expertise of the biophysical scientists. This may take many economists out of their comfort zone. However, our tools can be adapted and brought to bear at fine scale. In this context, the paper highlights the value of the Global‐to‐Local‐to‐Global approach to sustainability analysis. The third key point made in this paper is that economics offers a great organising framework for interdisciplinary projects. Too often we let the biophysical scientists frame the discussion prior to our involvement. This leads to frustration on the part of economists who are relegated to a secondary role in the project. However, if we lead the writing of the proposal and frame the overall discussion in economic terms, this gives rise to a very different dynamic which can facilitate coherent and meaningful economic analyses. Further, when economics is not used in the sustainability sciences, policy prescriptions are often limited at best, and misleading at worst. Finally, I have some suggestions for the teaching of interdisciplinary skills at the graduate level. Here, a well‐constructed course can benefit both the students as well as the instructor, fostering fruitful collaborations on grant applications, as well as generating new ideas for research in the sustainability sciences.

title: DP20487 Retail Investors’ Contrarian Behavior Around News, Attention, and the Momentum Effect
title_zh: 新闻、关注与动量效应背景下散户投资者的逆向行为
title_primary: 新闻、关注与动量效应背景下散户投资者的逆向行为
title_secondary: DP20487 Retail Investors’ Contrarian Behavior Around News, Attention, and the Momentum Effect
authors: Patrick Luo, Enrichetta Ravina, Marco Sammon, Luis Viceira
official: 官方在线 2025-07-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Using a large and representative panel of U.S. brokerage accounts, we show that retail investors trade as contrarians after large earnings surprises, especially for loser stocks, and that such contrarian trading contributes to price momentum and post earnings announcement drift (PEAD). We show that extreme return streaks and surprises are not enough for stocks to exhibit PEAD and momentum and that the intensity of contrarian retail trading plays a key role: the PEAD of loser stocks with bad earnings surprises becomes increasingly more negative as retail buying pressure increases, and he PEAD of the stocks with the highest past returns and largest earnings surprises is the most positive for the stocks with the biggest net retail outflow. Finer sorts confirm the results, as do sorts by firm size and institutional ownership level. Younger and more attentive individuals are more likely to be contrarian, and a firm’s dividend yield, leverage, size, book to market, and analyst coverage are associated with the fraction of contrarian trades they face around earnings announcements. The disposition effect and stale limit orders, while present in our sample, do not explain our results. Our findings are consistent with investors’ conservatism, sticky beliefs, and cognitive uncertainty, as well as an incorrect belief in the Law of Small Numbers.
abstract_zh: 利用美国经纪账户的大规模代表性面板数据，我们表明散户投资者在重大盈利意外后，尤其是对亏损股票，会进行反向交易，且此类反向交易促进了价格动量及盈余公告后漂移（PEAD）。我们证明，极端的收益连续性和意外本身不足以使股票表现出PEAD和动量，而反向散户交易的强度起着关键作用：对于盈利意外不佳的亏损股票，随着散户买入压力的增加，其PEAD变得越来越负；而对于过去收益最高且盈利意外最大的股票，其PEAD在散户净流出最大的股票中最为正向。更细分的分类确认了这些结果，按公司规模和机构持股水平的分类也是如此。较年轻且更为关注的个体更可能进行反向交易，而公司的股息收益率、杠杆率、规模、账面市值比和分析师覆盖度与盈余公告期间其面临的反向交易比例相关。处置效应和过期限价订单虽然存在于我们的样本中，但并不能解释我们的结果。我们的发现与投资者的保守主义、信念粘性、认知不确定性以及对小数定律的错误信念相一致。

title: DP19938 Does Unilateral Decarbonization Pay For Itself?
title_zh: 单边脱碳能否自我补偿？
title_primary: 单边脱碳能否自我补偿？
title_secondary: DP19938 Does Unilateral Decarbonization Pay For Itself?
authors: Adrien Bilal, Diego Känzig
official: 官方在线 2025-02-12 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper shows that unilateral decarbonization pays for itself in large economies. We estimate economic damages from global temperature shocks and combine them with a climate-economy model to construct Domestic Costs of Carbon: $226 per ton for the United States and $216 per ton for the European Union. When compared to marginal abatement costs, these values imply over 80% unilateral decarbonization for both economies, an order of magnitude larger than under conventional damages estimated based on local temperature.
abstract_zh: 本文表明，在大型经济体中，单边脱碳能够自我补偿。我们估算了全球温度冲击造成的经济损失，并将其与气候-经济模型相结合，构建了国内碳成本：美国为每吨226美元，欧盟为每吨216美元。与边际减排成本相比，这些数值意味着两个经济体可实现超过80%的单边脱碳，这一比例比基于当地温度估算的传统损害所隐含的水平高出一个数量级。

title: A Population Perspective on the Beneficiaries of Public and Private Assistance Immediately and Over the Long-Term After a Major Disaster
title_zh: 重大灾害后公共与私人援助受益者的即时与长期人口学视角分析
title_primary: 重大灾害后公共与私人援助受益者的即时与长期人口学视角分析
title_secondary: A Population Perspective on the Beneficiaries of Public and Private Assistance Immediately and Over the Long-Term After a Major Disaster
authors: Elizabeth Frankenberg, Nicholas Ingwersen, Cecep Sumantri, Duncan Thomas
official: 官方在线 2026-02-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Natural disasters undermine economic development, destroying lives, livelihoods, the built and natural environment. Public assistance programs follow, but knowledge of their reach, impact and evolution is limited. We address this gap, analyzing population-representative longitudinal survey data collected in Indonesia before and for two decades after the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami which was followed by a large recovery program involving multiple major actors. Those who lived, at the time of the tsunami, in communities that were badly damaged, were far more likely to receive aid and received larger amounts than residents of other areas immediately after the tsunami. Those gaps were small and insignificant four years post-tsunami. Conditional on exposure, individual attributes also shaped receipt which reached the vulnerable, particularly poor and female-headed households. Housing assistance, distributed several years post-tsunami to those who lost homes, was critical in the eyes of recipients, playing a key role as they rebuilt livelihoods.
abstract_zh: 自然灾害破坏经济发展，夺走生命，摧毁生计、建成环境与自然环境。随后会有公共援助项目跟进，但关于这些项目的覆盖范围、影响及其演变过程的知识却十分有限。我们针对这一空白进行了研究，分析了在2004年印度洋海啸之前及之后二十年期间，在印度尼西亚收集的具有人口代表性的纵向调查数据。海啸之后，一个涉及多个主要行动方的大型恢复项目随之展开。在海啸发生时居住于受损严重社区的人们，在海啸后立即获得援助的可能性远高于其他地区的居民，且获得的援助金额也更大。然而，在海啸四年后，这些差距已变得微小且不显著。在受灾害影响的前提下，个人特征也影响了援助的获取，援助惠及了弱势群体，尤其是贫困家庭和女性户主家庭。住房援助在海啸后数年发放给失去家园的人们，在受助者眼中至关重要，在他们重建生计的过程中发挥了关键作用。

abstract: We discuss the conditions under which global imbalances, such as China being a large foreign creditor and the United States being a large foreign debtor, might also generate power imbalances. title: Do Disinflation Policies Ravage Central Bank Finances?
title_zh: 反通胀政策是否损害中央银行财政？
title_primary: 反通胀政策是否损害中央银行财政？
title_secondary: Do Disinflation Policies Ravage Central Bank Finances?
authors: Théodore Humann, Kris James Mitchener, Eric Monnet
official: 官方在线 2023-06-27 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Summary Advanced-economy central banks are currently experiencing losses. To examine how rate-tightening cycles affect central bank finances, we study the financial statements of ten advanced-economy central banks during the 1970s and 1980s, the most notable and comparable policy environment to the present. We find that central bank profits actually increased in response to the anti-inflationary measures of the 1980s. We thus discuss how central bank profits depend on their policy instruments as well as their balance-sheet position when rate tightening begins, rather than on the tightening per se. Unlike today, central banks in the 1980s avoided losses because they did not remunerate bank reserves and their balance sheets did not carry the legacy of a decade of large asset purchases at low interest rates and long maturity. Our counterfactuals show that only a combination of these factors could have triggered losses in the 1980s: none of them is sufficient on its own. When losses emerged in the late 1970s, before the Volcker shock, they were due to foreign exchange reserves depreciating. In these instances, when central banks carried them forward and did not rely on transfers from the government, there was no loss of central bank independence or their ability to fight inflation.
abstract_zh: 发达经济体中央银行目前正面临亏损。为考察利率紧缩周期如何影响央行财务，我们研究了1970年代和1980年代十个发达经济体央行的财务报表，这一时期是与当前最具可比性的政策环境。我们发现，央行利润实际上因1980年代的反通胀措施而增加。因此，我们探讨了央行利润如何取决于其政策工具以及利率紧缩开始时的资产负债表状况，而非紧缩本身。与今日不同，1980年代的央行避免了亏损，原因在于它们不对银行准备金支付利息，且其资产负债表并未承载过去十年以低利率和长期限大规模购买资产所遗留的负担。我们的反事实分析表明，只有这些因素的组合才可能在1980年代引发亏损：单独任何一项都不足以导致亏损。当1970年代末期亏损出现时，早于沃尔克冲击，其原因是外汇储备贬值。在这些情况下，当央行将亏损结转且不依赖政府转移支付时，并未丧失央行独立性或其抗击通胀的能力。

title: How Important Is Internal Information Asymmetry for Firm-Level Productivity?
title_zh: 企业内部信息不对称对企业生产率的影响有多重要？
title_primary: 企业内部信息不对称对企业生产率的影响有多重要？
title_secondary: How Important Is Internal Information Asymmetry for Firm-Level Productivity?
authors: Vishal P. Baloria, Trent J. Krupa, David P. Weber
official: 官方在线 2026-08-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Theoretical research suggests internal information asymmetry (IIA) between top managers and divisional managers can reduce productivity by distorting internal resource allocation. The net effect, however, is unclear because IIA also reflects valuable private information within divisions, and empirical evidence is limited because of the unobservability of managers’ private information sets. Using a measure of IIA that exploits differences in returns to insider trading by top and divisional managers, we find that higher IIA is associated with lower total factor productivity. A one standard deviation increase in IIA corresponds to a 2.6% decrease in productivity relative to industry peers. This effect is comparable in magnitude to other important internal informational frictions, such as internal control weaknesses, and is distinct from internal information quality. Cross-sectional analyses indicate that the negative association is stronger when curative measures are limited and when agency conflicts between top managers and shareholders are greater. Mechanism tests indicate that IIA reduces internal capital market efficiency and increases underinvestment. Finally, using brokerage mergers and closures as a plausibly exogenous shock, we find that increases in IIA lead to declines in productivity. Overall, we provide empirical evidence that IIA is an economically important determinant of firm-level productivity. This paper was accepted by Jan Bouwens, accounting. Supplemental Material: The code and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08526 .
abstract_zh: 理论研究指出，高层管理者与部门管理者之间的内部信息不对称（IIA）可能通过扭曲内部资源配置而降低生产率。然而，由于IIA同时也反映了部门内部有价值的私有信息，其净效应尚不明确，且因管理者私有信息集合的不可观测性，实证证据有限。利用一种基于高层与部门管理者内幕交易收益差异来衡量IIA的指标，我们发现更高的IIA与更低的全要素生产率相关联。IIA每增加一个标准差，相对于行业同行，生产率下降2.6%。这一效应在规模上与内部控制缺陷等其他重要内部信息摩擦相当，并且与内部信息质量有所区别。横截面分析表明，当纠正措施受限以及高层管理者与股东之间的代理冲突加剧时，这种负相关关系更为显著。机制检验显示，IIA降低了内部资本市场效率并加剧了投资不足。最后，利用券商合并与关闭作为准自然实验冲击，我们发现IIA的增加导致生产率下降。总体而言，我们提供了实证证据表明IIA是企业层面生产率的重要经济决定因素。本文已被Jan Bouwens在会计学领域接受。补充材料：代码和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08526获取。

title: Demographics, Labor Market Power and the Spatial Equilibrium
title_zh: 人口结构、劳动力市场势力与空间均衡
title_primary: 人口结构、劳动力市场势力与空间均衡
title_secondary: Demographics, Labor Market Power and the Spatial Equilibrium
authors: Furbach, Nina
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Macroeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: This paper studies how demographics affect labor market power, the urban wage premium and the spatial concentration of population. Using disaggregated administrative data from Germany, I find that the labor supply elasticity to the firm decreases with age, suggesting that firms have more wage-setting power over older workers. I develop a quantitative spatial model in which labor market power depends on the composition of the local workforce. Calibrating the model with the reduced-form elasticity estimates shows that differences in labor supply elasticities across age groups explain 8% of the urban wage premium. Age and skill groups together account for 13%.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了人口结构如何影响劳动力市场力量、城市工资溢价及人口的空间集中。利用德国细分的行政数据，我发现企业对劳动力的供给弹性随年龄增长而下降，表明企业对老年工人拥有更强的工资设定权。我构建了一个定量空间模型，其中劳动力市场力量取决于当地劳动力的构成。通过将模型与简化形式的弹性估计进行校准，结果显示，不同年龄组间劳动力供给弹性的差异解释了城市工资溢价的8%。年龄与技能组共同解释了13%。

title: Distributional Consumer Price Indices
title_zh: 分配性消费者价格指数
title_primary: 分配性消费者价格指数
title_secondary: Distributional Consumer Price Indices
authors: Xavier Jaravel
official: 官方在线 2024-12-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper develops a new public database to estimate inflation heterogeneity across socio-demographic groups in the United States in real time. These distributional CPIs (D-CPIs) are fully consistent with the methodology of the official CPI and are available from 2002 to the present day by household income, age, race and other characteristics. Using this database, I establish three results showing that D-CPIs have important implications for the measurement of long-run trends in inequality and poverty, as well as of real wage dynamics during crises. First, "real" inequality across household income quintiles increased about 45 % faster with DCPIs between 2002 and 2019, compared to the official CPI. While the pre-tax income gap between the top and bottom household income quintiles increased by 15.6 % during this period according to the official CPI, it increased by 22.6 % with D-CPIs. Similarly large adjustments apply to consumption inequality and inequality in pre-tax and post-tax national incomes. Second, today 2.3 million people are below the "real" poverty line using D-CPIs but above the poverty threshold using the official CPI. Third, during the inflation burst following the Covid-19 pandemic, inflation was higher for the middle class, compared to low-income and high-income households. This pattern is driven by gas and vehicles and implies that the compression of "real" wages was about 25 % faster with D-CPIs than with the official CPI. Similar patterns of inflation heterogeneity hold in extensions allowing for geographic heterogeneity in inflation, non-homothetic price indices, and expanding the analysis back to 1983.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个新的公共数据库，用于实时估算美国不同社会经济群体的通胀差异。这些分配性消费者价格指数（D-CPIs）与官方CPI的方法论完全一致，并自2002年起至今，按家庭收入、年龄、种族及其他特征提供数据。利用该数据库，我得出三项结果，表明D-CPIs对衡量长期不平等和贫困趋势，以及危机期间实际工资动态具有重要意义。首先，在2002年至2019年间，使用D-CPIs衡量的家庭收入五分位组间的“实际”不平等增速比官方CPI快约45%。根据官方CPI，此期间最高与最低家庭收入五分位组间的税前收入差距增加了15.6%，而使用D-CPIs则增加了22.6%。类似的大幅调整同样适用于消费不平等以及税前和税后国民收入的不平等。其次，目前有230万人使用D-CPIs衡量处于“实际”贫困线以下，但根据官方CPI则高于贫困阈值。第三，在新冠疫情后的通胀爆发期间，中产阶级的通胀率高于低收入和高收入家庭。这一模式主要由汽油和车辆价格驱动，并意味着使用D-CPIs衡量的“实际”工资压缩速度比官方CPI快约25%。在允许通胀地理异质性、非齐次价格指数以及将分析扩展至1983年的扩展分析中，通胀异质性呈现出相似模式。

title: An auditable AI agent loop for empirical economics: A case study in forecast combination
title_zh: 可审计的人工智能代理循环在实证经济学中的应用：预测组合的案例研究
title_primary: 可审计的人工智能代理循环在实证经济学中的应用：预测组合的案例研究
title_secondary: An auditable AI agent loop for empirical economics: A case study in forecast combination
authors: Minchul Shin
official: 官方在线 2026-08-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: AI coding agents, general purpose assistants that write and execute code, make empirical specification search fast and cheap, but they also widen hidden researcher degrees of freedom. This paper adapts an open-source agent-loop architecture to an empirical economics workflow and adds a post-search holdout evaluation. In a forecast-combination illustration, independent agent searches find methods that improve on benchmarks from the original study. Logged search and holdout evaluation together make adaptive specification search more transparent and help distinguish robust improvements from sample-specific discoveries.
abstract_zh: AI编码代理，即编写并执行代码的通用助手，使得实证规格搜索变得快速且成本低廉，但同时也扩大了研究者隐藏的自由度。本文将开源代理循环架构适配至实证经济学工作流程，并增设搜索后保留样本评估环节。在预测组合的示例中，独立代理搜索发现的方法优于原始研究中的基准方法。结合日志记录的搜索过程与保留样本评估，使自适应规格搜索更加透明，并有助于区分稳健改进与样本特定发现。

title: Industrial composition of syndicated loans and banks’ climate commitments
title_zh: 银团贷款的行业构成与银行的气候承诺
title_primary: 银团贷款的行业构成与银行的气候承诺
title_secondary: Industrial composition of syndicated loans and banks’ climate commitments
authors: Galina Hale, Brigid Meisenbacher, Rami Najjar, Fernanda Nechio
official: 官方在线 2026-08-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In the past two decades, several banks have joined global initiatives aimed at enhancing the disclosure of their assets and climate commitments. We study whether banks that joined such initiatives have altered the emissions exposure of their syndicated loans. We rely on loan-level data with global coverage combined with country-industry data on emissions. We find that on average, banks have reduced the emissions exposure of their syndicated loans portfolio. However, we do not find statistically significant or robust differences between banks that did and those that did not subscribe to climate commitments. In the few instances where we found a statistically significant change after becoming a signatory to a climate initiative, the effect was temporary or did not survive our robustness testing. We conclude that, on average, while banks reduced their relative lending to high-emission sectors, voluntary climate commitments did not contribute to syndicated loan reallocation away from those sectors.
abstract_zh: 过去二十年间，多家银行加入了旨在提升资产与气候承诺披露水平的全球性倡议。我们研究了加入此类倡议的银行是否改变了其银团贷款的排放暴露。我们利用覆盖全球的贷款层面数据，结合国家-行业层面的排放数据进行分析。研究发现，平均而言，银行已降低了其银团贷款组合的排放暴露。然而，在签署与未签署气候承诺的银行之间，我们未发现统计上显著或稳健的差异。在少数情况下，我们发现成为气候倡议签署方后出现了统计显著的变化，但该效应或是暂时性的，或是未能通过我们的稳健性检验。我们得出结论：平均来看，尽管银行减少了对高排放行业的相对贷款，但自愿性气候承诺并未促使银团贷款从这些行业进行重新配置。

abstract: Childhood disability significantly impacts family members. Limited by data, prior research has faced challenges in measurement and identification and focused primar- ily on maternal labor outcomes. Utilizing 20-year-long administrative records from Taiwan’s National Health Insurance Research Database, we study cerebral palsy (CP), one of the most prevalent causes of childhood disability. We leverage its unexpected nature and our comprehensive data to investigate a broad spectrum of impacts on family members. Adopting an event study approach, we examine various outcomes, including parental labor supply, mental health, marital status, and fertility. Our find- ings reveal that having a child with CP decreases the mother’s likelihood of employ- ment by 6.2 percentage points (pp), increases the likelihood of divorce by 2.3 pp, and amplifies the risk of depression by 28%. Additionally, there’s a notable decrease in long-term fertility. These effects are more pronounced for parents in poorer socioeco- nomic conditions and for families with daughters who have CP.

abstract: When the Federal Reserve tightens monetary policy, do the prices of riskier assets fall relative to safer assets? Or, do investors interpret policy tightening as a signal that economic fundamentals are stronger than they previously believed, thus leading riskier assets to outperform? We present evidence that the latter of these two forces empirically dominates within the U.S. corporate bond market. Following an unanticipated monetary policy tightening, riskier corporate bonds outperform safer corporate bonds, demonstrating the importance of an informational, or nonmonetary, component within monetary policy announcements.
abstract_zh: 当美联储收紧货币政策时，风险较高的资产价格相对于安全资产是下跌还是上涨？或者，投资者是否将政策收紧解读为经济基本面比此前预期更为强劲的信号，从而推动风险资产表现更优？我们提供的证据表明，在美国公司债券市场中，后一种力量在实证层面占据主导地位。在意外货币政策收紧后，风险较高的公司债券表现优于更安全的公司债券，这凸显了货币政策公告中信息成分（或非货币成分）的重要性。

abstract: Raising the retirement age is a common policy response when social security schemes face fiscal pressures. We develop and estimate a dynamic life cycle model to study optimal retirement and tax policy when individuals face health shocks and income risk and make endogenous retirement decisions. The model incorporates key features of Social Security, Medicare, income taxation, and savings incentives and distinguishes three channels through which health affects retirement: nonconvexities in labor supply due to health-dependent fixed costs of working, earnings reductions, and mortality risk. We estimate our model to match US microdata and show that labor supply nonconvexities play a dominant role in driving early retirement, making rigid increases in the retirement age welfare reducing. In contrast, more flexible policies, such as increasing the dependence of Social Security benefits on the claiming age, can improve welfare and pay for themselves with a fiscal surplus. We map a range of policy reforms to their marginal values of public funds (MVPFs), showing that certain incentives to delay claiming offer MVPFs of infinity while broad-based retirement age increases have negative willingness-to-pay. These findings offer novel retirement policy prescriptions and challenge the prevailing emphasis on raising the retirement age.
abstract_zh: 提高退休年龄是社会保障体系面临财政压力时常见的政策应对措施。我们构建并估计了一个动态生命周期模型，以研究当个体面临健康冲击和收入风险并做出内生退休决策时的最优退休与税收政策。该模型整合了社会保障、医疗保险、所得税和储蓄激励的核心特征，并区分了健康影响退休的三个渠道：因健康依赖的固定工作成本导致的劳动力供给非凸性、收入减少以及死亡风险。我们通过匹配美国微观数据估计模型，发现劳动力供给非凸性在推动提前退休中起主导作用，这使得刚性提高退休年龄的政策会降低福利。相比之下，更灵活的政策（如增加社会保障福利对领取年龄的依赖程度）既能改善福利，又能通过财政盈余实现自我融资。我们将一系列政策改革映射到其公共资金边际价值（MVPF），发现某些延迟领取激励措施的MVPF为无穷大，而广泛提高退休年龄的政策则具有负支付意愿。这些发现提出了新颖的退休政策建议，并对当前强调提高退休年龄的主流观点构成挑战。

abstract: We investigate the impact of information disclosure, via a statistical instrument, on consumer welfare in competitive insurance markets with limited screening. We demonstrate that, under natural constraints on information disclosure, no statistical instrument is “safe” to implement. There always exists a nonnegligible set of prior beliefs about the risk types of consumers, compatible with an observed market situation, under which additional information disclosure strictly worsens welfare.

abstract: Vision problems are prevalent among Medicare beneficiaries, with the majority having treatable conditions including uncorrected refractive error and cataracts. However, traditional Medicare does not cover routine eye exams or eyeglasses, and Medicare Advantage supplemental vision benefits often include low annual limits. We examine the effects of Medicaid routine vision benefits among adults dually eligible for Medicare and Medicaid, a population with high rates of vision impairment, morbidity, and disability. Using 2002-2019 Medicare Current Beneficiary Survey data and a difference-in-differences design, we estimate that Medicaid routine vision benefits increase past-year eye exams, eyeglasses purchases, and Medicaid spending on eyeglasses while reducing out-of-pocket spending. We also find suggestive evidence of spillovers to Medicare Advantage spending on eyeglasses, consistent with Medicaid routine vision coverage inducing additional eyeglasses purchases among Medicare Advantage enrollees with supplemental vision benefits, although estimates are modest.
abstract_zh: 视力问题在医疗保险受益人中普遍存在，其中大多数人患有可治疗的眼部疾病，包括未矫正的屈光不正和白内障。然而，传统医疗保险并不覆盖常规眼科检查或眼镜，而医疗保险优势计划的补充视力福利往往设有较低的年度限额。我们研究了医疗补助常规视力福利对同时符合医疗保险和医疗补助资格的成年人的影响，这一人群视力损伤、患病率和残疾率较高。利用2002-2019年医疗保险当前受益人调查数据及双重差分设计，我们估计医疗补助常规视力福利增加了过去一年的眼科检查、眼镜购买及医疗补助在眼镜上的支出，同时减少了自付费用。我们还发现了对医疗保险优势计划眼镜支出溢出效应的提示性证据，这与医疗补助常规视力覆盖促使拥有补充视力福利的医疗保险优势计划参保者额外购买眼镜相一致，尽管估计值较为温和。

abstract: We study whether the net zero transition (NZT) affects loan pricing in the energy and utilities sectors of the loan market. We find that firms with higher levels of overall NZT disclosure experience a lower cost of debt in the loan market, controlling for loan-specific and firm financial characteristics. This effect is economically and statistically significant in Europe, but not in North America or emerging markets, and becomes more pronounced after the 2015 Paris Agreement. We also identify relevant NZT actions contributing to such a relation. Firms disclosing clear emission reduction targets aligned with the Paris Agreement enjoy lower loan spreads. Additionally, environmental R&D expenditure and improved energy efficiency policies are associated with lower loan spreads. Moreover, effective governance actions, such as environmental management training and ESG-linked executive compensation, help mitigate climate risks and lower loan spreads.
abstract_zh: 本文研究净零转型是否影响贷款市场中能源与公用事业部门的贷款定价。在控制贷款特定特征与企业财务特征后，我们发现净零转型整体披露水平较高的企业在贷款市场中的债务成本较低。这一效应在欧洲具有经济和统计显著性，但在北美或新兴市场并不显著，且在2015年《巴黎协定》后更为突出。我们还识别出促成该关系的相关净零转型行动：披露与《巴黎协定》一致的明确减排目标的企业享有较低的贷款利差；此外，环境研发支出与能源效率政策的改善也与较低的贷款利差相关。同时，有效的治理行动（如环境管理培训及与ESG挂钩的高管薪酬）有助于缓解气候风险并降低贷款利差。

abstract: This study examines the impact of school choice on academic achievement. I use differences in the number of schools across similar Romanian towns, generating variation in school choice for local students, who compete for seats via test scores. I find that more school choice results in increased sorting of students by admission scores across different schools. Sorting widens achievement gaps between high- and low-admission score students. High-scorers having access to better teachers and peer effects are the primary factors explaining these widening gaps. Last, between-school competition via school choice does not increase average achievement levels.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨学校选择对学业成就的影响。利用罗马尼亚相似城镇间学校数量的差异，当地学生通过考试成绩竞争入学名额，由此产生学校选择的变化。研究发现，更多学校选择导致学生按录取分数在不同学校间的分层加剧。这种分层扩大了高、低录取分数学生之间的成就差距。高分数学生能够获得更优质的教师资源和同伴效应，这是解释差距扩大的主要因素。最后，学校间通过择校机制形成的竞争并未提升平均学业成就水平。

abstract: We establish a link between labor scarcity and the adoption of labor-saving technology in industrializing England. During the Napoleonic Wars, more than 10 percent of the male population served in the armed forces. Where recruitment was heavy, more machines economizing on labor were adopted. Naval recruitment, instrumented by warships’ coastal access, provides exogenous variation in labor scarcity and suggests that the link between labor shortages and adoption is causal. Where mechanical skills were abundant, the impact of labor scarcity on adoption appears to be larger.

abstract: The social capital embedded in peers' parents can be a hidden but powerful force shaping adolescent development. This study investigates how peers from civil servant families impact adolescents' noncognitive outcomes within the same classroom. Using nationally representative data on middle school students in China and leveraging random classroom assignment, we find that greater exposure to classmates from civil servant families improves students' noncognitive skills, and is associated with higher friendship network quality and stronger teacher-student relationships. These positive effects are especially significant among boys, rural backgrounds, and low-SES households. Our findings contribute novel evidence on the role of peer social capital in influencing children's human capital development.

official: 官方在线 2026-07-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The recent surge in outward foreign direct investment (OFDI) from developing countries has sparked concerns that inadequate environmental regulations in these nations could result in adverse environmental impacts on host countries through such investments. Focusing on the typical representative of developing countries' OFDI, this study explores the impact of China's greenfield investment on green total factor productivity (GTFP) in host countries, and analyzes the moderating effect of environmental regulations on greenfield investment according to the theory of Directed Technical Change. The results indicate that China's greenfield investment significantly boosts the host countries' GTFP, balancing the relationship between economic development and environmental pollution. Mechanism analysis shows that China's greenfield investment promotes GTFP via industrial structure optimization and technological spillover effect. The former is significant at lower percentiles, while the latter only shows a learning effect without forming an overall demonstration effect to drive endogenous innovation. Compared with host countries' independent environmental regulation, relative environmental regulation presents more effective moderating effects. Heterogeneity tests confirm better moderating roles in medium intensity and developing host countries. This study offers valuable insights into how to better promote the green development impact of investments from developing countries.
abstract_zh: 近年来，发展中国家对外直接投资的激增引发担忧：这些国家环境规制不足，可能通过此类投资对东道国环境产生负面影响。本研究以发展中国家对外直接投资的典型代表为切入点，探讨中国绿地投资对东道国绿色全要素生产率的影响，并基于定向技术变革理论分析环境规制对绿地投资的调节效应。结果表明，中国绿地投资显著提升了东道国的绿色全要素生产率，平衡了经济发展与环境污染之间的关系。机制分析显示，中国绿地投资通过产业结构优化和技术溢出效应促进绿色全要素生产率提升：前者在较低分位数水平上显著，而后者仅呈现学习效应，尚未形成驱动内生创新的整体示范效应。相较于东道国独立环境规制，相对环境规制表现出更有效的调节作用。异质性检验证实，中等强度环境规制及发展中国家东道国的调节效果更优。本研究为如何更好促进发展中国家投资对绿色发展的影响提供了重要启示。

abstract: More frequent large macroeconomic shocks since the global financial crisis have entrenched uncertainty, particularly in Europe. This has increased the premium on central bank communication in guiding expectations and strengthening macroeconomic resilience. European central banks have responded by adapting their communication toolkits and styles. This study provides a systematic assessment of recent central bank communication across advanced and emerging European economies, combining a survey of institutional communication frameworks with novel text-miningbased indicators on monetary policy guidance in these economies over 2009-2025. While communication toolkits are broadly similar, their intensity and transparency differ markedly, with central banks in advanced economies making greater use of forward-looking tools. Central banks in both groups respond primarily to inflation uncertainty. However, communication strategies diverge, as central banks in advanced economies increasingly shift toward forward-looking language, whereas those in emerging markets shift toward more backward-looking communication. These patterns highlight credibility and institutional capacity as key determinants of central bank communication under uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 自全球金融危机以来，频繁发生的宏观经济冲击加剧了不确定性，尤其是在欧洲地区。这提升了央行沟通在引导预期和增强宏观经济韧性方面的价值。欧洲各国央行通过调整其沟通工具包和风格予以应对。本研究结合对机构沟通框架的调查，以及基于文本挖掘技术构建的2009-2025年欧洲发达与新兴经济体货币政策指引新指标，系统评估了近期欧洲各国央行的沟通实践。尽管沟通工具包大致相似，但其使用强度和透明度存在显著差异——发达经济体央行更频繁运用前瞻性工具。两组央行均主要对通胀不确定性作出反应，但沟通策略呈现分化：发达经济体央行日益转向前瞻性表述，而新兴市场央行则更多采用后顾式沟通。这些模式凸显了在不确定性环境下，可信度与制度能力是决定央行沟通策略的关键因素。

abstract: Preschool-aged children get sick frequently and spread disease to other family members. We combine birth order and within-municipality variation in respiratory disease prevalence among young children, finding lasting differential impacts of early-life respiratory disease exposure on younger siblings' earnings, educational attainment, chronic respiratory health, and mental health-related outcomes. abstract: Using longitudinal Young Lives data from Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, India, we examine the effect of noncognitive skills on cognitive abilities at the onset of adolescence and later adolescence, and address endogeneity by using siblings’ noncognitive traits and primary caregiver well-being as imperfectly excluded instruments for the focal child’s noncognitive abilities. Our results suggest that agency improves mathematical ability at the onset of adolescence, indicating a sensitive period of development. No similar effect on language abilities at the same stage indicates domain-specificity of agency effects. Self-efficacy has no effect on cognitive outcomes at either stage. We are unable to reject the null that agency and self-efficacy have no effect on cognitive abilities in later adolescence. Agency effects are concentrated among boys, consistent with theories of gender-specific socialization.
abstract_zh: 利用印度安得拉邦和特伦甘纳邦的纵向青年数据，我们考察了非认知技能对青春期初期及后期认知能力的影响，并通过将兄弟姐妹的非认知特征及主要照料者福祉作为焦点儿童非认知能力的不完全排除工具变量来处理内生性问题。研究结果表明，自主性在青春期初期能提升数学能力，这表明存在一个敏感发展期。同一阶段未发现对语言能力有类似影响，说明自主性效应具有领域特异性。自我效能感在两个阶段均未对认知结果产生显著影响。我们无法拒绝自主性与自我效能感对青春期后期认知能力无影响的零假设。自主性效应集中于男孩群体，这与性别社会化理论一致。

official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Previous studies have shown that aggregate shocks shape households’ financial conditions and influence their investment behaviour. However, literature provides mixed evidence on the persistence of household investment behaviour in the aftermath of such shocks. This study utilizes a large panel household dataset from India to analyse the investment choices of households in the aftermath of a nationwide pandemic. Our findings indicate that households that experienced adverse impacts on their financial conditions during the crisis have a 2.2% points higher likelihood of investing in relatively safe assets compared to other households. Importantly, a similar preference for safer assets persists in the post-crisis period for such households. This persistence is primarily driven by households whose financial conditions did not improve in the post-crisis period. We also find that financially-strained households’ preference for safer assets is lower in regions that are better banked. Our baseline results are robust to alternate definitions of safe and risky assets, crisis intensity, financially-strained households, potential selection bias, and placebo tests. Our findings suggest that alleviating financial strain and enhancing access to banking services can mitigate risk-averse behaviour both during a crisis and in the subsequent period.
abstract_zh: 已有研究表明，总体冲击会塑造家庭的财务状况并影响其投资行为。然而，关于此类冲击后家庭投资行为持续性的文献证据并不一致。本研究利用印度大规模家庭面板数据，分析全国性疫情后家庭的投资选择。研究结果显示，在危机期间财务状况受到不利影响的家庭，相较于其他家庭，投资相对安全资产的可能性高出2.2个百分点。重要的是，此类家庭在危机后时期仍持续表现出对安全资产的类似偏好。这种持续性主要由危机后财务状况未改善的家庭驱动。我们还发现，在银行服务更完善的地区，财务紧张家庭对安全资产的偏好较低。我们的基准结果在安全与风险资产的不同定义、危机强度、财务紧张家庭界定、潜在选择偏差及安慰剂检验中均保持稳健。研究结论表明，缓解财务压力并增强银行服务可及性，有助于在危机期间及后续时期降低风险规避行为。

title: Property size linked to deforestation, fragmentation and forest fires in the Brazilian Amazon
title_zh: 巴西亚马逊地区财产规模与森林砍伐、破碎化及森林火灾的关联
title_primary: 巴西亚马逊地区财产规模与森林砍伐、破碎化及森林火灾的关联
title_secondary: Property size linked to deforestation, fragmentation and forest fires in the Brazilian Amazon
authors: Ciar D. Noble, James J. Gilroy, Weslei Butturi, Carlos A. Peres
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-16 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Deforestation and forest degradation within Brazilian Amazonia primarily occur on private lands, yet their extent varies considerably among properties. We combine high-resolution remote-sensing and land-ownership data to analyse relationships between property size and forest retention, canopy height, fragmentation and fire prevalence across 30,022 private properties within an > 113,000 km2 consolidated agricultural frontier. Bayesian geospatial regressions showed that larger properties retained a greater proportion of forest overall and within Riparian Protected Areas and were more likely to adhere to Legal Reserve requirements. Properties > 1000 ha contained 75.2% of all remaining forest, while ≤ 150 ha properties accounted for the largest shares of total deforestation (27.6%) and riparian losses (39.9%). Smaller properties were also associated with lower-stature forest canopy, higher forest fire densities, and greater landscape-scale (∼100-km2) fragmentation, primarily due to increased disaggregation of forest among, rather than within, landholdings. Smaller properties thus not only retained less forest, but this forest was more degraded, underscoring the need to tailor policy interventions within Brazilian Amazonia according to property size. Targeted subsidies and credit schemes could enable smallholders to farm a smaller portion of their land, restore forest and reduce reliance on degrading land-use practices (e.g., fires). Fines, embargoes, and stricter Forest Code enforcement may help preserve remaining forest and reduce fire use in largeholdings. Incentivising forest restoration across property boundaries, and offsetting forest cover deficits to remaining continuous forest tracts, would help minimise fragmentation. Implementing these measures will depend on collaboration between government agencies and NGOs to align enforcement, financing, and coordinate landscape-scale management.
abstract_zh: 巴西亚马孙地区的森林砍伐与退化主要发生在私有土地上，但其程度在不同地产间差异显著。我们结合高分辨率遥感与土地所有权数据，分析了超过113,000平方公里已整合农业前沿地带内30,022处私有地产的规模与森林保留、冠层高度、破碎化及火灾发生率之间的关系。贝叶斯地理空间回归显示，较大地产总体上保留了更高比例的森林，且在河岸保护区内的森林保留比例也更高，更可能遵守法定保护区要求。面积超过1000公顷的地产保留了全部剩余森林的75.2%，而面积不超过150公顷的地产则贡献了总森林砍伐量（27.6%）和河岸损失（39.9%）的最大份额。较小地产还与较低冠层高度的森林、较高的森林火灾密度以及更大尺度（约100平方公里）的景观破碎化相关，这主要归因于土地持有间而非土地内部的森林分散化加剧。因此，较小地产不仅保留的森林较少，且这些森林更为退化，凸显了在巴西亚马孙地区根据地产规模定制政策干预措施的必要性。定向补贴和信贷计划可使小农户仅耕作其土地的一小部分，恢复森林并减少对退化土地利用方式（如火灾）的依赖。罚款、禁运及更严格的《森林法》执行可能有助于保护大地产生存森林并减少火灾使用。激励跨地产边界的森林恢复，并将森林覆盖赤字抵消至剩余连续森林地块，将有助于最小化破碎化。实施这些措施将依赖于政府机构与非政府组织之间的合作，以协调执法、融资及景观尺度管理。

abstract: This study examines the competitiveness between Latin American and U.S. livestock and meat sectors. We employ a computable general equilibrium modeling framework to evaluate two scenarios: coordinated improvements in Latin American productivity, transport efficiency, and market access (Scenario I), and the minimum productivity gains required in the U.S. to regain its competitive position given improvements from Scenario I (Scenario II). Results highlight Latin America's transformative potential through advancements in technology, infrastructure, and trade, while emphasizing the importance of U.S. strategies to maintain market leadership. Policy implications focus on innovation, supply chain efficiency, and trade agreements to ensure sustained global competitiveness.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了拉丁美洲与美国畜牧及肉类行业的竞争力。我们采用可计算一般均衡模型框架，评估两种情景：拉丁美洲在生产率、运输效率和市场准入方面的协同改进（情景一），以及在此改进基础上，美国为恢复其竞争地位所需的最低生产率提升（情景二）。结果显示，拉丁美洲通过技术进步、基础设施建设和贸易拓展展现出变革潜力，同时强调了美国维持市场领导地位策略的重要性。政策启示聚焦于创新、供应链效率及贸易协定，以确保全球竞争力的持续。

abstract: We examine how social interactions and friendships shape students’ political opinions in a natural experiment at Sciences Po, a leading French university specializing in social and political sciences. The quasi-random assignment of students into short-term integration groups before their academic curriculum reduces political opinion gaps and fosters friendship formation. Using same-group membership as an instrumental variable for friendship, we find that friendship reduces opinion differences by 44 percent of the mean opinion gap. Our evidence supports a homophily-enforced mechanism: Friendships form among initially politically similar students, leading them to join political associations together, reinforcing their similarity. abstract_zh: 我们通过法国顶尖社会科学与政治学府——巴黎政治学院的一项自然实验，考察社会互动与友谊如何塑造学生的政治观点。学生在学术课程开始前被准随机分配至短期融合小组，这一机制缩小了政治观点差距并促进了友谊形成。以同组归属作为友谊的工具变量，我们发现友谊使观点差异缩小了平均差距的44%。研究证据支持一种同质性强化机制：友谊最初在政治立场相近的学生间形成，促使他们共同加入政治社团，从而进一步强化其观点相似性。（JEL C93, D72, Z13）

title_zh: 贸易战中进口关税与出口税的非等价性：从价税与从量税的比较
title_primary: 贸易战中进口关税与出口税的非等价性：从价税与从量税的比较

authors: Helmuts Azacis, David R. Collie
official: 官方在线 2026-05-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using a perfectly competitive, general equilibrium model of international trade, specific import tariffs, specific export taxes and ad valorem trade taxes are compared in a trade war. A trade war is modelled as a Nash equilibrium in trade policies, where each country can choose to use ad valorem trade taxes (import tariffs or export taxes, which are equivalent), specific import tariffs or specific export taxes. In the two‐country case, where there is a negative terms of trade externality a specific export tax dominates a specific import tariff or ad valorem trade taxes. Hence, the Lerner symmetry theorem does not hold for specific trade taxes in a trade war. This result continues to hold when the model is extended to the case of many countries assuming that there is a negative terms of trade externality. In a trade‐policy game where two countries export the same good so that there is a positive terms of trade externality in the trade‐policy game between these two countries, the results are reversed, with a specific import tariff dominating a specific export tax or ad valorem trade taxes. Hence, the Lerner symmetry theorem again does not hold for specific trade taxes.
abstract_zh: 利用一个完全竞争、一般均衡的国际贸易模型，在贸易战中比较了特定进口关税、特定出口税和从价贸易税。贸易战被建模为贸易政策中的纳什均衡，其中每个国家可以选择使用从价贸易税（进口关税或出口税，两者等价）、特定进口关税或特定出口税。在两国情形下，存在负的贸易条件外部性时，特定出口税优于特定进口关税或从价贸易税。因此，勒纳对称定理在贸易战中对特定贸易税不成立。当模型扩展到多国情形，并假设存在负的贸易条件外部性时，这一结果依然成立。在两国出口相同商品从而在这两个国家间的贸易政策博弈中存在正的贸易条件外部性的情况下，结果则相反，特定进口关税优于特定出口税或从价贸易税。因此，勒纳对称定理再次对特定贸易税不成立。

abstract: Abstract Not very. We find even the most destructive weather disasters over the last quarter century had only modest effects on U.S. banks' performance. This stability seems endogenous rather than a mere reflection of federal disaster aid, as disasters tend to increase loan demand, which helps offset losses and boosts profits. Local banks avoid mortgage lending where floods are more common than official flood maps would predict, suggesting local knowledge may also mitigate disaster impacts. Our findings inform ongoing assessments of the physical risks to banks from climate change.

official: 官方在线 2026-02-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: If public provision of public goods is potentially suboptimal, then why do states still intervene to provide them? This question parallels the broader inquiry into whether state provision can be explained without resorting to justifications invoking the public interest, or suboptimal private provision. This paper shows that whether states take over the provision of public goods depends on the political rents that can be secured in markets beyond the one for the public good itself. This creates a redistribution that is wide enough to secure sufficient buy-in from key interests (sustaining an equilibrium). Using the federalization of American lighthouses in the Early Republic (1789–1815) as a case study makes clear that this shift was not merely administrative. Rather, federal control was part of a rent-seeking arrangement that embedded subtle, yet significant, protectionist measures for the domestic shipping industry, created a broader “hidden tariff” often overlooked in economic history, and expanded patronage opportunities for political machines at both the state and federal levels. This example can be extended to other key historical episodes with implications for our understanding of the causes and consequences of state takeovers of the provision of public goods.

abstract: The marginal propensity to consume (MPC) is heterogeneous and depends on liquidity, while liquidity is affected by both temporary circumstances and persistent characteristics. Using bank account transaction data and a survey of its account holders, this study aims to distinguish the sources of MPC heterogeneity. The results indicate that individuals with higher levels of risk aversion and time discount rates tend to exhibit a higher MPC, whereas lower wealth is also linked to a higher MPC. These findings suggest that MPC heterogeneity is influenced by both temporary and persistent factors.
abstract_zh: 边际消费倾向（MPC）具有异质性，并受流动性影响，而流动性既受临时状况也受持久特征的影响。本研究利用银行账户交易数据及其账户持有人的调查，旨在区分MPC异质性的来源。结果表明，风险厌恶程度较高和时间贴现率较高的个体倾向于表现出更高的MPC，而较低财富水平也与更高的MPC相关联。这些发现表明，MPC异质性受到临时因素和持久因素的共同影响。

abstract: Sustainable growth has emerged as a critical policy challenge worldwide. We investigate the influence of conventional gender norms on fertility and economic growth to explain the phenomena recently observed across high-income countries. To this end, we construct an overlapping generations model with endogenous fertility and labor supply, incorporating gender norms and R&D activities. We demonstrate that conventional gender norms can impede fertility and economic growth. Specifically, when gender norms are sufficiently conservative, income growth stagnates and population erosion eventually occurs. Our results underscore the need to address and correct gender norms to achieve sustainable growth and improve welfare.
abstract_zh: 可持续增长已成为全球面临的关键政策挑战。我们考察传统性别规范对生育率和经济增长的影响，以解释近期高收入国家观察到的现象。为此，我们构建了一个包含内生生育率和劳动供给、并纳入性别规范与研发活动的重叠世代模型。我们证明，传统性别规范可能阻碍生育率和经济增长。具体而言，当性别规范足够保守时，收入增长停滞，人口萎缩最终发生。我们的结果强调，为实现可持续增长并改善福利，有必要正视并纠正性别规范。

title: The establishment of environmental courts and the ESG performance of heavy polluters: based on China’s Quasi-nature experiments

abstract: The environmental court is an institutional innovation for a country to strengthen environmental governance, which is facing critical challenges posed by heavy polluters. Therefore, it is worthwhile to examine how environmental courts can address the problem by influencing polluting businesses’ behaviors. Given the important function of ESG (environmental, social, and corporate governance), this study explores the impact of the establishment of environmental courts on the ESG performance of heavily polluting businesses. Using tripartite game and difference-in-differences (DID) methods, this study analyzes the behavior of individual business listed in China’s heavily polluting industries from 2010 to 2022. Our findings indicate that the establishment of environmental courts significantly contributed to improved ESG performance of heavily polluting businesses, and that the level of environmental information disclosure and the intensity of environmental regulation are important mechanisms of this contribution. These findings offer valuable policy implications for government to promote regulatory framework.
abstract_zh: 环保法庭是国家加强环境治理的一项制度创新，正面临着重污染企业所带来的严峻挑战。因此，探讨环保法庭如何通过影响污染企业的行为来解决这一问题具有重要意义。鉴于ESG（环境、社会和公司治理）的重要功能，本研究探讨了环保法庭的设立对重污染企业ESG表现的影响。采用三方博弈和双重差分法（DID），本研究分析了2010年至2022年间中国重污染行业上市企业的个体行为。研究发现，环保法庭的设立显著促进了重污染企业ESG表现的提升，且环境信息披露水平和环境规制强度是这一促进作用的重要机制。这些发现为政府完善监管框架提供了有价值的政策启示。
